name: VRM_FP_TEMPLATES_INTERIM
description: VRM_FP_TEMPLATES_INTERIM contains the templates which are in the process of FMV calculation.

columns.name: FMV_PRICE_TYPE
columns.description: Fair market value price type. Price type can be either VSOE, TPE, or ESP. Values are from the lookup VRM_FMV_TYPES. This column is obsoleted for usage.

columns.name: DATA_SELECTION_TIME_SPAN
columns.description: Number of coverage periods that a VSOE price calculation process will gather the standalone sales from.

columns.name: MINIMUM_LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Minimum number of standalone sales required in order to calculate a valid VSOE price.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_HIGH
columns.description: Higher limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_RANGE_COVERAGE
columns.description: The required minimum percentage of standalone sales that its unit selling price falls within tolerance range price of an item.

columns.name: COVERAGE_RANGE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of a coverage period.

columns.name: COVERAGE_RANGE_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of a coverage period.

columns.name: USE_TOLERANCE_FOR_COMPLIANCE
columns.description: A flag that indicates if a tolerance range should be used during compliance validation process of a MEA line or not. This column is obsoleted for usage.

columns.name: FMV_REPRESENTATION_TYPE
columns.description: FMV price representation type. The value is derived from VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS lookup type.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
